leah: Found a pasted GCP service-account JSON in a staging log object. s3 path: s3://redwood-staging-logs/partner/2026-03-21/app.log.gz :rotating_light:

maria: thanks, leah. can you confirm whether the key is wrapped (KMS) or plaintext?

leah: plaintext. full JSON blob was in the stacktrace lines. low traffic but partner might have access. copied snippet to the ticket.

alex: ok — treat as exposed creds. immediate actions: 1) revoke the key, 2) create replacement SA with least privilege, 3) rotate any tokens that used it. I can run revokes if someone gives me the key id.

sam: I started a ticket INC-2026-042 and pinned the log snippet + s3 object. @oncall-bot created the incident channel.

leah: key id: 0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h8i. alex, please proceed. also we should rotate any Vault entries that referenced this SA.

alex: running revoke now: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete 0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h8i --iam-account=staging-partner@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com`

alex: revoke succeeded. created new key and uploaded to secrets manager staging. created PR to update k8s secret ref. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1245

devops: deploying updated k8s secret to staging (rolling restart for the deployment). command I ran: `kubectl -n staging set env deployment/partner-api --from=secret/partner-sa --record`

maria: vault implications: search for any Vault KV entries with that SA email and rekey them. also enable audit logging for the Vault mount if not already enabled so we can trace reads. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cred-rotation

sec-bot: Recommended next steps checklist added to INC-2026-042: [containment, rotate, rewrap backups, RBAC restrict, audit enable, postmortem].

sam: two additional items: 1) rewrap any archived backups (S3) that might include the blob, 2) run a grep-sweep across logs/archives for similar past occurrences. I can schedule the sweep job.

leah: grep-sweep over last 90 days scheduled (job ID sweep-2026-03-21). will share results in the ticket.

maria: RBAC temporary harden: restricted iam.roles/iam.serviceAccountKeyAdmin for dev teams until we finish the audit (24h). Sam, can you push the IAM constraint?

sam: done. created ephemeral policy and applied to dev project: `gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-staging --member=group:devs@redwood.com --role=roles/viewer` and removed SA key admin role. details in INC-2026-042.

alex: quick note on KMS/Vault integration: backups that we re-encrypt should be rewrapped with the current keyring using `gcloud kms encrypt --key=projects/.../locations/.../keyRings/.../cryptoKeys/current-key` so we avoid using the old key material. I'll run the rewrap script for affected objects.

devops: deployment to staging rolled out. health checks passing.

maria: timeline proposed: T0 immediate revoke (done), T+1h new key deployed (done), T+4h archive sweep started, T+24h postmortem + remediation report. please add any open tasks to INC-2026-042.

leah: thanks everyone. quick wins covered. I'll collect artifacts for the postmortem and tag partners. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 assigned to @maria, severity: low-medium, SLA start: 4187654321.

sec-bot: Reminder: keep artifacts (log copies, gcloud commands, policy diffs) attached to the ticket for audit compliance.

maria: will run a short sync 30m from now with owners. ping me if you need access to the evidence bucket.

alex: after the postmortem we should add an automated detector to alert on JSON-looking blobs in logs (pattern: "type": "service_account" && "private_key_id"). I'll prototype a lambda rule.

sam: added follow-up task: create detection playbook + alerting rule (task ID TASK-2026-198).

leah: closing loop for now. I'll post results of the sweep to the incident thread when complete.
